records.verificationNote: Read directly from Highmark Comprehensive Formulary drug-search pages for the GLP-1 and dual GIP/GLP-1 weight-management classes. Every weight-loss GLP-1 on the plan is Tier 3 with PA: generic liraglutide (Liraglutide (Weight Loss)) pen, Saxenda, Wegovy pens/tablets/HD, Zepbound, and Foundayo tablets (listed under the GLP-1 class; not in the taxonomy). Zepbound carries a Member Note icon whose text was not read. The preferred pick is the lowest-cost barrier-level product: the generic liraglutide pen (Tier 3, PA, no quantity limit). Anti-Obesity PA policy (Commercial and Healthcare Reform) revisions are on April 2026 update pages 13-14 (Wegovy HD added 04/03/2026; baseline BMI defined within 6 months, 02/19/2026; Zepbound single-dose requires contraindication to Kwikpen). Policy criteria text beyond these revisions was not read. [Sonnet check 2026-10-21: Highmark legend (re-read on the live site) defines Tier 3 as "Non-Formulary Drug" that closed-formulary members do not get, so "covered, higher cost share" was overstated and Tier 3 alternatives now carry that caveat. aom-glp1 inn now labeled weight management. Spot-checked on the live site: Aimovig 140 mg/mL is Tier 2 + QL + PA; Concerta 18 mg is Tier 3 + QL, no PA; both match.]
